name: Expansion // Explosion
oracle_text:
Copy target instant or sorcery spell with mana value 4 or less. You may choose new targets for the copy.
Explosion deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
blocked_sentences: Copy target instant or sorcery spell with mana value 4 or less.

needs.what: let `copy_spell` name its victim by target -- a `target` key read the way `counter` reads one, resolving a declared target of kind "spell" through `ctx.target_sids` -- so "Copy target instant or sorcery spell" (Fork, Reverberate, Twincast, Expansion) can copy a spell somebody else cast rather than only the spell the ability hangs off
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `copy_spell` (src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_stack.py, op_copy_spell) reads exactly one way of naming the victim: `spec["sid"]` through `evaluate_value`, defaulting to `ctx.bindings["sid"]` -- the sid a `spell_cast` trigger carries, which is why storm, replicate, conspire, casualty, gravestorm and demonstrate all work and all copy *themselves*. A card-level target of kind "spell" is a TargetRef of kind "stack" reachable only through `ctx.target_sids` (src/automtg/engine/effects/context.py:68), and there is no value expression that yields a sid: `evaluate_value` (src/automtg/engine/effects/values.py:206 onward) has no `target` form at all -- the `{"target": ...}` shape exists only inside `_characteristic`, which returns power/toughness/mana value off an *object* oid, not a stack id. So `{"sid": {"target": "t1"}}` is an unparsable value expression, and `copy_spell` silently ignores a bare `target` key and falls back to a `sid` binding this spell does not have -- it would copy nothing, or the wrong spell, with no error. `counter` (ops_stack.py:242) and `return_spell_to_hand` (ops_cards.py:655) are the only ops that read `ctx.target_sids`, and both remove the spell instead of copying it; `cast_copy` (ops_counters.py:484) copies the ability's own card out of exile, not anything on the stack. Note that the rest of the sentence is NOT blocked and should not be re-filed: `new_targets: true` on `copy_spell` already says "You may choose new targets for the copy", the `mana_value` selector key already says "with mana value 4 or less" as `{"mana_value": {"op": "<=", "value": {"const": 4}}}`, and the Explosion half ({X}{U}{U}{R}{R}: `damage` at a kind-"any" target plus `draw` at a kind-"player" target, both with `{"x": true}`) is fully expressible today -- only the copy-a-targeted-spell verb is missing.
